mapper.insert: insert ignore into verification_review (verifier_member_id, topic_id, risk_type, verification_rate, paid_count, verified_count, one_minute_count, status, idempotency_key, create_time) values (#{verifierMemberId}, #{topicId}, #{riskType}, #{verificationRate}, #{paidCount}, #{verifiedCount}, #{oneMinuteCount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) as pendingCount, coalesce(timestampdiff(second,min(create_time),now()),0) as oldestAgeSeconds from verification_review where status=0

select current_topic.topic_id as topicId,
(select product_type from cms_topic where id = current_topic.topic_id) as productType, (select count(1) from cms_registration paid left join cms_activity paid_activity on paid.owner_type = 2 and paid_activity.id = paid.owner_id where paid.payment_status = 2 and coalesce(paid.topic_id, case when paid.owner_type = 1 then paid.owner_id else paid_activity.topic_id end) = current_topic.topic_id) as paidCount, count(distinct scan.registration_id) as verifiedCount, sum(case when scan.create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 minute) then 1 else 0 end) as oneMinuteCount from (select coalesce(registration.topic_id, case when registration.owner_type = 1 then registration.owner_id else activity.topic_id end) topic_id from cms_registration registration left join cms_activity activity on registration.owner_type = 2 and activity.id = registration.owner_id where registration.id = #{registrationId}) current_topic join cms_registration_scan scan on scan.member_id = #{verifierMemberId} and scan.registration_type = 1 and ifnull(scan.status, 0) <> 2 join cms_registration scanned_registration on scanned_registration.id = scan.registration_id left join cms_activity scanned_activity on scanned_registration.owner_type = 2 and scanned_activity.id = scanned_registration.owner_id where coalesce(scanned_registration.topic_id, case when scanned_registration.owner_type = 1 then scanned_registration.owner_id else scanned_activity.topic_id end) = current_topic.topic_id group by current_topic.topic_id

select id, verifier_member_id, topic_id, risk_type, verification_rate, paid_count, verified_count, one_minute_count, status, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from verification_review where id = #{id}
